div.ab: Gif preost anes dæges mæssige oftor þonne ðríwa, gilde XII ór.
Gif preost anes dæges mæssige oftor þonne ðriwa, gilde XII or.
If a priest celebrates mass more often than three times in one day, he is to pay 12 ores.
If a priest holds Mass more often than three times in one day, he is to pay twelve oras.
Wenn ein Priester an Einem Tage öfter als dreimal Messe liest, zahle er 12 Ör.
If a priest says mass more than three times in one day, let him pay 12 ores.
div.note: Liebermann compares Canons of Edgar 37.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a priest celebrates mass more often than three times each day, he is to pay 12 ores.’).
